name: odometer
title: Odometer
description: A number whose digits roll like a mechanical counter, forward or back, the long way round.

perf.budget: One spring per changed digit column on the UI thread; layout transitions only when the number gains or loses columns.

measurements.notes: Frames at rest in the measurement came from the demo changing its value every few seconds; with a fixed value nothing redraws.

a11y.reducedMotion: Digits change in place without rolling; no column transitions.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as one text element with the formatted value. Set `announce` to read changes aloud (live region).
